name: Chronica
purpose: Trace what happened, what changed, and what every scene now makes true.
stopConditions: The scene resolves an intentionally open question

visualIdentity.silhouette: A ring-bound mechanical timeline whose event plates connect to visible downstream consequence loops; no floating clocks or nostalgic scrolls.
visualIdentity.material: Inked linen strips, oxidized silver rings, archival paper, and dark wood registration blocks worn by handling.
visualIdentity.light: A warm archival beam follows one changed event into three later consequences; the rest stays quietly legible.
visualIdentity.workingBehavior: Chronica moves one corrected event plate and the downstream rings realign, revealing exactly which later claims must change.
visualIdentity.spatialRhythm: Linear time crossed by sparse causal loops; clear before-and-after reading direction.
